cases.sentence: В конце концов остались только Иисус и ___.
cases.translation: In the end, only Jesus and the woman remained.
cases.explain: Женщина is nominative because, together with Иисус, it is the subject of the verb остались (remained).

cases.sentence: Вы отсюда, с ___, а я пришел свыше.
cases.translation: You are from here, from the earth, but I have come from above.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) governs the genitive case, giving земли.

cases.translation: I am the light of the world.
cases.explain: Миру is dative, showing the recipient ("to/for the world") of the light Jesus brings, with no preposition needed for this dative of recipient.

cases.sentence: Кто из вас без греха, пусть первым бросит в нее ___.
cases.translation: Whoever among you is without sin, let him be the first to throw a stone at her.
cases.explain: Камень is accusative, the direct object of the transitive verb бросить (to throw); for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative form matches the nominative.

cases.sentence: Иисус склонился и писал ___ на земле.
cases.translation: Jesus bent down and wrote with his finger on the ground.
cases.explain: Пальцем is instrumental, naming the instrument used for writing, with no preposition required for this instrumental of means.

cases.sentence: Рано утром он опять был в ___.
cases.translation: Early in the morning he was again in the temple.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in), used with a location meaning, requires the prepositional case, giving храме.

cases.translation: They made her stand before the people.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before/in front of) governs the instrumental case, giving народом.

reading.ru: А Иисус пошел на Масличную гору.
reading.question: Where did Jesus go at the start of this chapter?
reading.explain: The chapter opens by saying Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

reading.ru: Рано утром он опять был в храме.
reading.question: When did Jesus return to the temple to teach the people?
reading.explain: The text says early in the morning he was again in the temple.

reading.ru: Учители закона и фарисеи привели женщину, уличенную в супружеской измене.
reading.question: Who brought the woman caught in adultery to Jesus?
options: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees
reading.correct: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees
reading.explain: The text states the teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought the woman.

reading.ru: Моисей повелевает в законе побивать таких камнями, а ты что скажешь?»
reading.question: What did the accusers say Moses' Law commanded for a woman caught in adultery?
options: To banish her from the city
reading.explain: They tell Jesus that Moses commands in the Law to stone such women with stones.

reading.ru: Иисус склонился и писал пальцем на земле.
reading.question: What did Jesus do while the accusers kept pressing him for an answer?
options: He bent down and wrote on the ground with his finger
He stood up and walked away
reading.correct: He bent down and wrote on the ground with his finger
reading.explain: The text describes Jesus stooping down and writing with his finger on the ground.

reading.ru: «Кто из вас без греха, пусть первым бросит в нее камень».
reading.question: What condition did Jesus set for who could throw the first stone?
options: Whoever among them was without sin
reading.correct: Whoever among them was without sin
reading.explain: Jesus says whoever is without sin among them should throw the first stone.

reading.ru: В конце концов остались только Иисус и женщина.
reading.question: Who was left after the accusers departed one by one?
reading.explain: After the accusers left starting with the oldest, only Jesus and the woman remained.

reading.ru: «И я тебя не осуждаю», — сказал Иисус. «Иди и больше не греши».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the woman after declaring he did not condemn her?
options: Go and confess to the priests
reading.explain: Jesus tells her, "I do not condemn you either. Go and sin no more."

reading.ru: «Я свет миру. Тот, кто идет за мной, не будет ходить во тьме, но будет иметь свет жизни».
reading.question: What did Jesus declare himself to be when he spoke to the people again?
reading.explain: Jesus declares, "I am the light of the world," promising followers will not walk in darkness.

reading.ru: Даже если я и сам свидетельствую о себе, мое свидетельство истина, потому что я знаю, откуда я пришел и куда я иду.
reading.question: Why did Jesus say his testimony about himself was true, even though he testified about himself?
options: Because he knows where he came from and where he is going
Because two Pharisees agreed with him
Because Moses had written about him
Because the crowd voted in his favor
reading.correct: Because he knows where he came from and where he is going
reading.explain: Jesus explains his testimony is true because he knows his origin and his destination.

reading.ru: Он сказал это, когда учил в храме, там, где собирали пожертвования.
reading.question: Where in the temple was Jesus teaching when he said these things about himself and the Father?
options: Near the treasury, where offerings were collected
On the temple steps facing the crowd
reading.correct: Near the treasury, where offerings were collected
reading.explain: The text notes he taught this in the temple, in the place where offerings were collected.

reading.ru: «Я ухожу, и вы будете искать Меня, и умрете во грехе вашем. Туда, куда Я иду, вы не сможете прийти».
reading.question: What warning did Jesus give about what would happen if the people did not believe?
options: They would die in their sin and could not come where he was going
They would be expelled from the synagogue
They would lose their inheritance from Abraham
They would become blind like the Pharisees
reading.correct: They would die in their sin and could not come where he was going
reading.explain: Jesus warns that they will die in their sin and cannot come where he is going.

reading.ru: Они ответили, «Мы потомки Авраама и никогда не были никому рабами. Как это мы можем стать свободными?»
reading.question: How did the people respond when Jesus said the truth would set them free?
options: They said they were Abraham's descendants who had never been slaves
They immediately believed and thanked him
They asked to be baptized at once
They accused him of blasphemy on the spot
reading.correct: They said they were Abraham's descendants who had never been slaves
reading.explain: They reply that they are Abraham's offspring and have never been anyone's slaves.

reading.ru: Вы принадлежите вашему отцу, дьяволу, и хотите исполнить желание вашего отца.
reading.question: According to Jesus, whose desires were his opponents really carrying out?
options: The devil's, whom Jesus called their father
reading.correct: The devil's, whom Jesus called their father
reading.explain: Jesus tells them they belong to their father the devil and want to carry out his desires.

reading.ru: Тогда они схватили камни, чтобы бросить в него, но Иисус скрылся и вышел из храма.
reading.question: How does the chapter end after Jesus says, "Before Abraham was born, I am"?
options: The crowd picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid and left the temple
The crowd fell down and worshiped him
The temple guards arrested Jesus on the spot
The Pharisees publicly apologized to Jesus
reading.correct: The crowd picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid and left the temple
reading.explain: In response, they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and left the temple.
